property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer must revert if any individual low-level call to the provided caddress fails (i.e., the reference propagates call failures), whereas the mutant that ignores failed calls will not revert for some inputs where a callee reverts.
change_summary: Remove the revert on failed calls so the function ignores individual call failures and continues, changing the final observable state when some calls fail.
